releases.displayName: Free Empyreal Content Update Coming August 7th

items.text: Hey everyone,
Last week we teased a few things coming to the game in an upcoming update, so here are more details on what's coming to your game on August 7th!
Illusory Orb

During a playthrough, you will be able to re-customise all aspects of your character at any time in The Hub! Add scars as you venture through the monolith so your character tells a story, or try out different hair colours and styles to switch things up!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfGSf_5v0QPEtbhR3qGTsI26HG8iY2VACqPQOOiDoQpoNN9EhRmVZPGvXp5A_7Yv8w8S2WtaRvK1JvQ77BY8ajvcNX266iQDibNTG4zkj_ufOFJ9V8IaApH6RiY6U12cqSxj5hFrQ?key=Hi7ZqyKFraOx-bqIewMZS1Xx"]
Transmogrification System

Don’t like the look of your high-level Armour? That's not a problem. Now you can keep those stats while rocking a different look! Armour & Weapons can have their appearance swapped with other Equipment you've obtained.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvBKy7ZM-nuuV1c4Qt-BX1TnD5wSvuL1O_cpS0oF1_jxh__aNr71kYixt6lT9LffYKHTThbf1j32xJYwg60-4P8wtzj7Cfh1WmozccPuAAwYhsGxegLX4iiF6jP4Vc3ARUEbxI3A?key=Hi7ZqyKFraOx-bqIewMZS1Xx"]
New Hub Vendor

A Mini-Mage will join you in The Hub to help with all your Transmog needs, providing you with Armour and working his magic to make them appear as desired! The little fella will be available after you complete the first World and Life cartogram!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc09DGMrmSW5tvbQQMqhJXfDmn6ev_cjRery-JAefCynLTs_d2iQ5kA02jDogUGivBy1KOreHwzMrSzcKrW2CRHnCkbj3Q2GLMkC5vjsTP6ImSUl8_7WUJPy3CY0Tsle_4BiGv-vg?key=Hi7ZqyKFraOx-bqIewMZS1Xx"]
Alongside these new features, there will also be plenty of bug fixes and other improvements coming on August 7th. We’ll share full patch notes as the update rolls out.
Stay up to date with the latest Empyreal news and be the first to know about updates by joining our Discord, following us on X, Bluesky and TikTok.

releases.displayName: Minor Empyreal Update Now Live - Patch Notes

items.text: Hello folks,
We rolled out our first major patch for Empyreal a week-and-a-half ago that addressed quite a lot of things, but our team is keen to add some more improvements!
Today's patch is a small one that brings optimisations to some Ultimates, Abilities, and Sets, as well as bug fixes.

notes.title: Below are the full set of patch notes for this update

items.text: Final Boss Aerial Abilities now have longer cooldowns (reduces total time he can spend in the air).
Super Nova (Ultimate) will now pull Enemies to its epicentre with greater effect.
The projectiles spawned by The God of Death Looks Down (Ultimate) will now auto-target Enemies.
Flay (Ultimate) initial damage and bonus damage increased significantly.
New Auto-Save Trigger has been added to collecting Items from the Mailbox.
Fixed Bug that caused Killing Blow Damage Numbers to fail to display on Final Bosses and NPCs.
Summons will no longer target "downed" Enemies I.E. in Duels.
Stat Tooltips added to Modification Screen.
NPCs defeated with a Coup de Grace during a Duel will now correctly enter their knockdown state.
Reduced damage of the explosion triggered by Modified Vanish (Depth & Silence Set).
Vanish cooldown has been moderately increased.
Drain Essence cooldown has been moderately increased.
Meteoric Slam damage increased (affects both normal and modified versions).
Modified Force Punch (Man & Church Set) damage increased significantly.
Healing & Barrier received via Modified Bubble Shield (Word & Life Set) improved significantly.
Perfectly timed Modified Bubble Shield (Word & Life Set) now reloads and levels up ALL Ammo.
The duration of Stasis Chamber is now increased by Player's Debuff Duration Stat.
Increased Radius of Stasis Chamber, making it easier to ensnare Enemies.
This patch is available now to all players on all platforms. Let us know what you think of the tweaks!
\Stay up to date with the latest Empyreal news and be the first to know about updates by joining our Discord, following us on X, Bluesky and TikTok.

releases.displayName: New Empyreal Update Out Now: Full Patch Notes

items.text: Hey everyone,

The latest update for Empyreal is rolling out now across all platforms. Our biggest update since launch in early May focuses on adding community-requested features, balances to improve the early-game experience, and gameplay optimisations across the entire game.

Thank you so much to the Empyreal community for your thoughts and helpful feedback in recent weeks, which has helped shape this key update. We’d love to hear your thoughts on what’s added and changes, so don’t hesitate to join the development team over on Discord, or speak up over on Steam Discussions.

notes.title: Below are the full set of patch notes for this update

items.text: Implemented Objective Tracker System for the HUB area
Reduced Enemy Power at Early Levels (1-21)
Player Stun Duration reduced from three seconds to two seconds
Added three-second Grace Period after being stunned that prevents being immediately stunned again
Reduced Stun Build-Up on specific Enemy Abilities
Reduced the number of Minions summonable by Bosses below Level 15
Changes made to prevent Players immediately getting hit before they regain control
Adjusted all character Backgrounds - increased their damage and improved their starting consumables
Reduced Damage of Consumed from 100% of Player Shields to 60%
Increased Consumable Slots in Stash from 100 to 400
Changed Aether Touched additional effect from -30% to one Resistance to +20% to one Resistance
Limit Broken Equipment now sells for significantly more Silver than normal Equipment
Modified Summon's Attack Command now triggers on all three Summons
Fix for Shocked Damage ticks not being triggered by Cannon
Ensure that Apparitions do not reappear after being interacted with
Fix for Assassin and Skirmisher activating abilities in mid-air
Prevented Zosimei's Constructs spawning Projectiles when destroyed
Edmund's Ultimate Ability will now correctly end when he is defeated
Fix Arbalest flashing visible prior to intro animation
Fixed hidden helmets becoming visible when entering Final Boss battle
Additional Shocked Damage will now apply on Shocked Targets regardless of triggering damage type
Boss Ability Sacrifice now correctly changes the orb colour of constructs
Increase chance of Captain / Champion block entering cooldown
Increase chance of Assassin / Skirmisher Dodge entering cooldown
Decreased maximum distance of Skirmisher Jumps
Ensure Skirmisher cancels retreat behaviour when invisibility wears off
Reduced camera shake and range of Gunner and Wasp projectiles
Adjusted Final Boss debuff to make it slightly more forgiving
Increase Shield Wall damage boost from absorbing enemy attacks
Adjusted VFX of Ice Barricade to better telegraph element and location of projectiles
Reduced camera shake of Impact Shield (Fire)
Fix for mailbox not saving inventory upon sending an item on console versions
In New Game+ and beyond, Isolda will now correctly engage in combat when she becomes your Ally
Prevented Story Cartograms from being droppable so they cannot be lost
Fixed bug that caused valid results to fail to display when Filtering Cartograms for Sets in Player Inventory
Added Equip prompt to Curio Equip screen
Adjusted Chthonic Harvest making it much easier to connect with Enemies when used
Fixed Bug that caused Shield Restore IV to trigger twice when used
Prevented Credits from playing when exiting "Final Trial - The Empyreal Arena"
Fixed bug that caused Morys to incorrectly appear in the Firmament under specific
Fixed Bug that caused Isolda and Edmund to incorrectly appear in the Firmament under specific circumstances
Increased healing significantly of Drain Essence Ability
Reduced Stun and Impact of Hail (Boss Ultimate Ability)
Significantly improved drop rate of Pure Quartz treasure
Buffed Summonable Friendly Servitors, increased their damage and improved their behaviour. Additionally, when self-destructing they will now move towards an Enemy before exploding.
Allowed Weapon Coatings to Limit Break their respective stats temporarily
Fixed issue causing a soft lock during dialogue when attempting to craft Mind & Truth Ultimate Ability in New Game+
Fixed issue where Enemies became temporarily immune to damage under specific circumstances
Ensured that Weapon Specific Ultimate is always auto-equipped from Edmund's dialogue
Blacksmith is now accessible from the Anvil as well as the Forge at nighttime
Ensured Isolda encounters don't trigger after relevant story events have occurred
Fix for the same secondary stat always showing the same mod options (on the same item) when modifying equipment
Increased Juggernaut wall impact damage
Obliterate bonus granted by Invigorating Smash is now correctly enhanced
Stability Consumable changes: added Fortitude buff, Movespeed debuff lowered, duration increased
Slightly reduced base damage on all Grenades
Internal cooldown added to Shocked Damage ticks
Healing provided by Shield Restore III significantly increased

Alcohol adjustments: Orden Brown Ale - Increased Ultimate Energy gain; Honey Mead - Lowered Shield Restoration Bonus; Saint Aalis Wine - Increased Elemental Damage Bonus while lowering Elemental Build Up Bonus
Adjusted Sound Effects to several interactables: Voice in the Darkness Apparitions, Boss Teleporters, Cartogram Machine, Aether Tear, Chests and more
Added new detonated Sound Effects to Elemental detonations
Updated multiple material instances to produce improved SFX
Adjusted non-player character voiceover volume
New SFX when receiving an item based on item rarity
Improved SFX for several Boss Abilities
Added new or improved existing SFX for multiple player/enemy Combat Abilities/Effects
Boosted Player Light in Word & Life and Mind & Truth
Fixed a bug that prevented Area of Effect Abilities from displaying properly in the Empyreal Arena
Fixed several instances of specific equipment clipping into the character or other equipment
Fixed instances where the player could get stuck in specific locations
New animation for Hanwyn when he uses his Ultimate Ability in combat
Made it easier to spot Skirmishers and Assassins while they are invisible
Increased duration of Defence Down Debuff from stun on enemies (allowing the Coup de Grace to take advantage of the lowered defences)
Prevented the Final Boss from attacking the moment the player steps into the Arena
Made Elemental Mine Charges infinite while under the effects of Energy Overload
Using an Ultimate will now completely prevent any Enemy Movement for the duration of the camera cut
Compartmentalise will no longer target invalid entities
Adjusted Enemy Attack Tracking to be significantly less aggressive; enemies are more likely to miss if the player moves
Improved VFX for multiple Enemy Abilities
Assigned correct rarity colour to the pickups for Man & Church and Mind & Truth Curios
Fatboys now remain Stunned for longer after dropping their Nuke
Fixed incorrect damage calculation on Shocked Tick Damage that resulted in unexpectedly large numbers
Unity will now refresh its duration when used while effect is already active
Multiple Curios that didn't have special effects now do: John's Requests, Isolda's Relics, John's Schematics and the Unidentified Cartogram now all provide bonuses when Equipped
Prevented Cartograms with 0 Uses Remaining for a specific player from being visible by that player in the Trading Post
Fixed issue where Weapons generated from Cartogram Loot Tables or the Aether were always using their default models
For a deeper look at some of these changes, check out this video from the Silent Games team.
Stay up to date with the latest Empyreal news and be the first to know about updates by joining our Discord, following us on X, Bluesky, and TikTok.

releases.displayName: Empyreal Update Coming June 19: Quest Tracker, Difficulty Balancing & More

items.text: Hey folks,

Thank you to everyone in the Empyreal community who has shared their thoughts in reviews, Steam discussions, and our Discord since the game’s launch! We’ve been reading it all and we’re using this feedback to focus on what changes to make in the game’s first post-launch update, which is set to arrive on all platforms on June 19.

There are a lot of fixes coming in this patch - almost 100 individual changes in all - but particular focuses were around addressing player feedback on enemy difficulty, and finding Characters/Objectives in The Hub . Here are some of the key changes to expect:
1. Enemies from Levels 1-21 have had their overall power reduced.
2. An Objective Tracker for The Hub has been added so you’ll never lose track of where you’re going next.

notes.title: 3. We’ve made some changes to Stun

items.text: Player Stun Duration reduced from three seconds to two seconds.
Added three second Grace Period after being stunned that prevents being immediately stunned again.
Reduced Stun Build-Up on specific Enemy Abilities.
4. The damage of Consumed after being Smogged has be taken down a notch from 100% to 60%.
For the second point, here’s a little visual preview of what this objective tracker will look like:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311533/6e5809b2a0669ee7a045a56e6656088e3f9f53c3.png"]
We’ll share full patch notes outlining all the changes when this update rolls out on June 19, and we look forward to hearing what you think about these community-driven tweaks!
Stay up to date with the latest Empyreal news and be the first to know about updates by joining our Discord, following us on X, Bluesky and TikTok.
